gdp_level.source: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.CN · GDP at current prices, Egyptian pound million, annual.
gdp_level.description: The total value of everything Egypt produces in a year, at current prices. Years are Egypt's fiscal years, July to June, labelled by the year in which they end. Annual only: Egypt's quarterly national accounts are not available to automated downloads.
gdp_level.real: “Make it real” swaps this to GDP at constant prices (World Bank), also annual. This strips out the effect of price changes, so it shows genuine output growth rather than growth that's really just inflation.
gdp_level.dollar: “Dollarise” converts each year at its own EGP/USD rate (World Bank PA.NUS.FCRF, annual average).

gdp_real.source: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KN · GDP at constant prices, Egyptian pound million, annual.
gdp_real.description: GDP adjusted for inflation, so changes reflect real output growth rather than price changes.
gdp_real.real: This IS the “Make it real” series, toggling it off shows GDP at current (nominal) prices instead.
gdp_real.dollar: Same historical-rate matching as GDP (current prices): each year converted at its own EGP/USD rate.

gdp_growth.source: World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.KN · change in real GDP on the previous year, to one decimal place.
gdp_growth.description: How much the economy grew or shrank compared with the previous year, in real terms. Annual only on this page.
gdp_growth.real: This is already a real (inflation-adjusted) growth rate, “Make it real” has no additional effect on it.
gdp_growth.dollar: A growth rate (%) is currency-agnostic, converting the underlying Egyptian pounds to dollars doesn't change the percentage change. “Dollarise” has no effect on this figure.

cpi.source: IMF consumer price index (CPI, EGY.CPI._T.YOY_PCH_PA_PT.M), from CAPMAS, Egypt's statistics agency · all items, change on the same month a year earlier as the IMF publishes it, to one decimal place, monthly.
cpi.description: How much consumer prices are rising compared with a year ago. This is the IMF's all-items consumer price index for Egypt.

cpi_mom.source: IMF consumer price index (CPI, EGY.CPI._T.POP_PCH_PA_PT.M) · all items, change on the previous month as the IMF publishes it, not seasonally adjusted, to one decimal place.
cpi_mom.description: How much consumer prices moved compared with the month before.

unemployment.source: World Bank SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS · International Labour Organization modelled estimate, % of the labour force, annual.
unemployment.description: The share of the labour force that wants a job and is actively looking, but can't find one. This is the ILO's modelled estimate, not the statistics office's own survey rate.

exports.source: IMF international trade in goods (ITG) · exports of goods, free on board, US$ converted to Egyptian pounds at the BIS monthly average rate, monthly.
exports.description: The value of goods Egypt sells to the rest of the world each month, in Egyptian pounds.
exports.dollar: Egypt's customs figures are in US dollars; the Egyptian pounds shown are converted at each month's BIS average rate, and “Dollarise” converts back at that year's World Bank rate.

imports.source: IMF international trade in goods (ITG) · imports of goods, cost, insurance and freight, US$ converted to Egyptian pounds at the BIS monthly average rate, monthly.
imports.description: The value of goods Egypt buys from the rest of the world each month, in Egyptian pounds.
imports.dollar: Egypt's customs figures are in US dollars; the Egyptian pounds shown are converted at each month's BIS average rate, and “Dollarise” converts back at that year's World Bank rate.

trade_balance.source: IMF international trade in goods (ITG) · exports (free on board) less imports (cost, insurance and freight), US$ converted to Egyptian pounds at the BIS monthly average rate, monthly.
trade_balance.description: Exports minus imports of goods each month. Below zero means Egypt buys more from abroad than it sells.
trade_balance.dollar: Egypt's customs figures are in US dollars; the Egyptian pounds shown are converted at each month's BIS average rate, and “Dollarise” converts back at that year's World Bank rate.

debt_gdp.source: IMF World Economic Outlook (GGXWDG_NGDP) · general government gross debt, % of GDP, annual · actual years only. The IMF's figures for the years after the one shown are projections, which this site does not publish.
debt_gdp.description: Everything government owes, across all levels of government, compared with the size of the economy.
debt_gdp.dollar: Already expressed as a % of GDP, currency-agnostic. “Dollarise” has no effect on this figure.

deficit.source: IMF World Economic Outlook (GGXCNL_NGDP) · general government net lending/borrowing, % of GDP, annual · actual years only. The IMF's figures for the years after the one shown are projections, which this site does not publish.
deficit.description: The yearly gap between government spending and revenue as a share of GDP; negative means a deficit. This covers all levels of government.
deficit.dollar: Already expressed as a % of GDP, currency-agnostic. “Dollarise” has no effect on this figure.

current_account.source: World Bank BN.CAB.XOKA.GD.ZS · % of GDP, annual.
current_account.description: Egypt's overall balance with the rest of the world, trade in goods and services plus net investment income and remittances, as a share of GDP.
current_account.dollar: Already expressed as a % of GDP, currency-agnostic. “Dollarise” has no effect on this figure.

fdi.source: World Bank BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS · % of GDP, annual.
fdi.description: Money invested into Egyptian businesses from abroad each year (foreign direct investment), as a share of GDP.
fdi.dollar: Already expressed as a % of GDP, currency-agnostic. “Dollarise” has no effect on this figure.

fx_usd.source: World Bank series PA.NUS.FCRF · official exchange rate, annual average, shown as US$ per E£100 (100 ÷ the published EGP per US$).
fx_usd.description: How many US dollars E£100 buys. A rising number means a stronger pound.
